_help: Each entry overrides scraped data for one team/book. Only the keys you include are applied; null clears a value (shows '-'). If you change 'total' without giving a price for a side, the scraped price for that side is dropped. Teams: canonical abbreviations (BOS, BKN, NYK, ...). Books: draftkings, fanduel, betmgm, caesars. Example: {"team": "BOS", "book": "caesars", "total": 50.5, "over": -115, "under": -105, "note": "from Caesars app 10/5"}
